knobs.note: BH-1770. How long a run-build.sh lane may live (from job.json's started_at) before bin/lane-reaper.sh kills it as ABANDONED_TIMEOUT. PER BUILD LANE: set lane.lane-reaper.<project>.lane_reap_deadline_secs for one project's builds (bin/harness-ctl.sh set lane-reaper LANE_REAP_DEADLINE_SECS <secs> <project>), or the lane-wide row for every other. Read by bin/lane-reaper.sh through lane_knob with the build's project; a row is clamped to min/max. 16200 is the old flat 4h30m (LANE_EXPECTED_SECS 14400 + LANE_REAP_GRACE_SECS 1800), and a box that tuned that pair keeps its sum as the env tier. A reaped run is relaunched by bin/blocked-resolver.sh, never by the sweep.

Seconds between the SIGTERM and the SIGKILL of a lane that is past its deadline. Read by bin/lane-reaper.sh as ${LANE_REAP_KILL_WAIT_S:-30}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible and settable; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.
